_comment: Transcribed from in-game screens captured 2026-08-05 (Steam captures 20260805170252 NATO art, 170239 Pax Armata art, 170234 Breacher, 170236 Frontliner). The class active ability is recorded once on the class rather than on each training path because both path screens show the same LVL 03 entry. Descriptions are reproduced exactly as the game prints them, including the acute accent the game uses in place of an apostrophe.
name: Assault
_alias_note: No bare "assault" alias. The matcher treats word boundaries as breaks, so it would tag every Assault Rifle and Assault Ladder line in the log to this page. Training path and ability names are distinctive enough to stand on their own.

description.text: The ultimate frontline fighter, skilled at punching through enemy defenses. Dominate close to mid-range encounters and limit the enemy´s ability to fight.

ability.name: Rally Squad
ability.description: You and nearby squad members gain a temporary adrenaline effect. Its effects on you can be extended with kills.

training_paths.name: Breacher
training_paths.description: Highly combat effective and skilled at maneuvering. Break through enemy lines with effective use of small explosives and grenade launchers.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Reload
abilities.description: 15% faster reload for the Incendiary-Round Shotgun and the Grenade and Breaching Projectile Launchers.

abilities.name: Agile Shooter
abilities.description: Reduced movement speed penalty when firing while moving.

abilities.name: Extra Grenades
abilities.description: Increases the amount of grenades carried by one.

training_paths.name: Frontliner
training_paths.description: Experts at leading their squad into hostile territory. Locate enemy positions to launch surprise attacks and gain the upper hand.

abilities.name: Quick Recovery
abilities.description: Passive health regeneration triggers 50% faster and provides a 50% improvement on healing.

abilities.name: Soft Landing
abilities.description: Reduced impact from falling or jumping from heights.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Squadmates that deploy on you gain the effects of the Adrenaline Injector for 2s. Effects also apply to you or squadmates when deploying on your Deploy Beacon.

_tag_deny_note: Three different things wear this word. The Assault Ladder and the assault rifle category have their own pages; Conquest Assault is a Portal variant of a mode. Masked out before matching so the class page only collects lines about the class.

redsec._source: Transcribed from the in-game REDSEC class details screen, Steam capture 20260812180236. The lobby banner reads 17/100 players, so this is a Battle Royale lobby and not core multiplayer. Training paths transcribed from the in-game SELECT TRAINING PATH screen, Steam captures 20260815211122 (Pointman) and 20260815211121 (Hazmat Breacher). The lobby banner reads 98/100 players, so this is a Battle Royale lobby and not core multiplayer.

signature_set.name: Assault Ladder
signature_set.description: This equipment provides access to higher vantage points. Depending on the angle of placement, it can act as a bridge between buildings, or a ramp to help traverse obstacles on the battlefield.

signature_set.name: High Explosive Launcher
signature_set.description: Fires impact-triggered grenades designed for damaging structures and targeting infantry behind cover. Can be carried standalone or underslung on weapons with a Gadget Mount attachment for faster access.

signature_set.name: Assault Rifle Proficiency
signature_set.description: Faster draw times and fire sooner when exiting a sprint with Assault Rifles.

signature_set.name: Mission Focused
signature_set.description: Nearby squadmates get faster progress with objectives, including arming and disarming M-COM explosives. In Battle Royale, respawn towers will capture quicker, and in modes where squadmates can redeploy on you, a quicker cooldown for your in-combat state lets them deploy on you sooner.

passive.name: Stockpile
passive.description: Class gadget resupply rate increases by 10% with each improvement. Effect resets upon death.

training_paths.name: Pointman
training_paths.description: Gain the high ground and eliminate enemies from defilade.

abilities.name: Cluster Munitions
abilities.description: High Explosive Launcher explosions generate 5 fused submunitions.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.description: High Explosive Launcher carrying capacity increased to 5 rounds.

training_paths.name: Hazmat Breacher
training_paths.description: Learn to thrive on a hazardous battlefield and utilize special equipment to break through enemy front lines.
training_paths._note: EA named this path in 1.2.3.0 and 1.3.1.0 long before it was captured, calling Tracker “Level 3” in its own numbering. The screen prints LVL 03, so the two agree.

abilities.name: Tracker
abilities.description: Equipping the Protective Mask within 20m of an enemy affected by VL-7 reveals their position.

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.description: Passive health regeneration triggers 50% faster and provides a 50% improvement on healing. Revive sickness recovery time reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Enhanced Filtration
abilities.description: While in use the Protective Mask improves sprint speed by 10%. Increases Protective Mask duration and recharge rate by 20%.

universal_equipment.name: Upgraded Armor
universal_equipment.description: Standard small-arms issue tactical vest insert. Provides base-line ballistic protection.

universal_equipment.name: Thermite Sabotage
universal_equipment.description: Improvised sabotage device which slowly damages a tank and its crew.

redsec._paths_note: The Aug 12 capture is the CLASS DETAILS screen, which prints the equipped path's abilities under a bare TRAINING heading and never names the path. The Aug 15 capture is the SELECT TRAINING PATH screen, which names it and shows the tiles: this class has two, and the three abilities recorded on Aug 12 are Pointman's. That supersedes the earlier reading that REDSEC runs a single unnamed four-level track. The LVL 04 passive is printed on both path screens, so it sits above them rather than inside either.
